name: casa-lucenzo
description: Sistema de gestión de inventario y caja para Casa Lucenzo.

scripts.test: node tests/intl-cache.test.js && node tests/script-order.test.js && node tests/unit.test.js && node tests/sale-price-rules.test.js && node tests/build.test.js && node tests/day-report.test.js && node tests/delivery-note.test.js
scripts.release:web: npm run build && git push origin HEAD:main
scripts.release:desktop: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop run publish
scripts.release: npm run test && npm version patch -m "release v%s" && npm run release:web && npm run release:desktop && git push --tags
